repair_notes.claim_and_conventions: Declared ideal harmonic model with mass m>0, spring constant k>0, omega=sqrt(k/m)>0, scalar position x and length-valued parameter alpha, momentum p and momentum-valued Jacobi constant beta. H=p^2/(2m)+m omega^2 x^2/2 has energy dimension and S has action dimension. On each strip J_n=(n pi/omega,(n+1) pi/omega), S:J_n x R x R -> R is smooth; S_xalpha=-m omega/sin(omega t) is finite and nonzero. Solving beta=S_alpha yields x=alpha cos(omega t)-beta sin(omega t)/(m omega) and p=-m omega alpha sin(omega t)-beta cos(omega t), so p=m x' and p'=-m omega^2 x. Only these explicit motions, not S or S_alpha, continue to the excluded times. Initial-momentum-labelled motions through (t0,x0) refocus at (t0+pi/omega,-x0). These are deductions from model parameters with no empirical inputs or observations.
